correctness.rationale: The full Binet ratio in the étale quadratic residue algebra produces the iff p|Q_n criterion n/e_p odd. Odd-exponent p-adic LTE and p∤e_p recover all p-adic gcd exponents. Two-adic layer compatibility proves the exact finite inclusion–exclusion. The explicit prime bound and Q_e size produce a convergent O(1/log Y) tail; limit existence follows by comparing upper/lower densities. Saved verifier independently reproduces the exact 11-event rational upper bound, upward-rounded 100000-prime sum, 10000 index gcd tests, and 167 rank tests. Finite checks complement, not replace, the analytic proof.

originality.rationale: Within primary full text and the six actual indexed-result searches, no claim matched the compound associated Pell local gcd classification, parity-stratified density formula, and certified numerical interval. Originality is not attributed to density existence, known for general recurrences by Sanna, nor to Fibonacci rank density, known by Sanna–Tron. The motivating 2023 paper asks for gcd(Q_k,k) and gives only an incomplete entry-point criterion. Residual risks include unindexed identical calculations, standard general second-kind Lucas rank treatments, and possible alternate derivations from prior group-theoretic theory.

value.rationale: Self-index coprimality is natural in recurrence divisibility; the paper explicitly raises this gcd as an unfinished Pell invariant. The proved gcd exponents and odd-quotient phase are a structural classification, not a check of isolated values. The exact effective sieve makes the natural density calculable and provides the first inspected certified quantitative interval, 0.812–0.878. The interval is broad and the methods are elementary, but the combined exact parameterization and rigorous global bounds have concrete independent use.
